account_ledger_entries_fee_month_check.name: account_ledger_entries_fee_month_check
account_ledger_entries_fee_month_check.value: ("billing"."account_ledger_entries"."fee_month" is not null) = ("billing"."account_ledger_entries"."kind" in ('late_fee', 'late_fee_dismissed')) and ("billing"."account_ledger_entries"."fee_month" is null or "billing"."account_ledger_entries"."fee_month" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$')

reconciliation_years_finalized_check.name: reconciliation_years_finalized_check
reconciliation_years_finalized_check.value: "billing"."reconciliation_years"."status" <> 'finalized' or ("billing"."reconciliation_years"."finalized_at" is not null and "billing"."reconciliation_years"."letter_date" is not null)

transactions_bank_check.name: transactions_bank_check
transactions_bank_check.value: "billing"."transactions"."source" <> 'bank' or ("billing"."transactions"."bank_account_id" is not null and "billing"."transactions"."import_batch_id" is not null and "billing"."transactions"."raw_row_hash" is not null)

transactions_cash_check.name: transactions_cash_check
transactions_cash_check.value: "billing"."transactions"."source" <> 'cash' or ("billing"."transactions"."bank_account_id" is null and "billing"."transactions"."import_batch_id" is null and "billing"."transactions"."raw_row_hash" is null and "billing"."transactions"."amount_cents" < 0)
